data.title: Nvidia announces plug and play Vera Rubin racks that can be shipped on a truck
data.description: Nvidia says its DSX Pod AI Factory, which combines seven Vera Rubin racks in a shipping container, could cut the time to start serving AI tokens to 14 days.
